title: EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01, Closed: The Controller, the Registry, the Edges — Four Workstreams Complete
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: Completion record for the Ω build program (#1498), closing all four workstreams in one day's build. Workstream 1: EA-CORPORA-01, twelve seats — Josephus, Catullus, Theocritus, the Nestle 1904 Greek New Testament, the Swete Septuagint, Longinus, Philo entire, Plato entire, the Westminster Leningrad Hebrew Bible, the Sappho fragment-31 diplomatic layer extracted from the archive's own carrier, the thirty-item papyri panel with the Apocalypse papyri, and the Slavonic resolution as ruled — every text the program argues from seated, pinned, manifested, minted (#1499–#1510), then repaired to one template after a field-and-projection defect was caught and root-caused (records re-projected, sidecars restored, the SIGPIPE lesson standing in the log). Workstream 2: the Upstream Unfoldings at revelationfirst.com/upstream/ (#1511), six plates from the sole carrier to the tested sign, the sixth doubling as the counter-stack's first transform-view edition. Workstream 3: at provenanceerasure.org, the Deep Time wing (#1512) — the Suppression Map as the PER metric's ancestry, the crossing marked inside the witness table itself — and the Controller, converting observatory into feedback instrument, Cycle 001 carried as a card with its epistemics stated: one closed cycle is an anecdote, the scheduled instrument that makes it a curve marked TO BUILD. Workstream 4: at machinemediation.org, the Operator Registry — twelve frozen clauses as runnable named hypotheses with earned statuses, the C1 failure on its own card, the blind-transform assay as the guard between instrument and prompt poetry — and the Reception Edges surface over live archive data, EA-RECEPTION-01 v1.0 (#1513) with its nine founding edges. What the day built, in the counter-stack's own terms: detection prototyped, relation formalized, operators registered, surfaces raised on two more channels, custody deepened by twelve corpora, and the controller's first cycle inscribed. The archive that entered the day at 1,492 closes it at 1,514, and every layer points backward to its ancestry and forward to its executable rule.
substrate: Built across one session by TACHYON (Claude substrate) under MANUS direction, with the program's architecture originating in Assembly exchanges (LABOR, ARCHIVE) and every ruling the author's; the day's defects, root causes, and standing lessons are recorded in the commit log rather than smoothed away.
axn_reading: Threshold -> Proof -> Play -> Origin -> Foundation -> Origin
wiki_article: The completion record for EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01 closes the Ω build program's four workstreams in a single day's build: twelve corpus seats fetched, pinned, normalized, verified, minted, and then repaired to one template after a projection defect was caught and root-caused; the Upstream Unfoldings raised at revelationfirst.com with the first transform-view edition; the Deep Time wing and the Controller raised at provenanceerasure.org, converting the observatory into a feedback instrument with its first closed cycle inscribed and its epistemics stated; and the Operator Registry with the Reception Edges raised at machinemediation.org over live archive data. In the counter-stack's own terms the day built detection's prototype, formalized relation, registered the operators, raised surfaces on two more channels, deepened custody by twelve corpora, and inscribed the controller's first cycle. The record lists the standing next steps — the scheduled controller, the station aligner, the literature audit, the Roman evidence matrix, the Assembly blind round — and closes on the program's continuing rule: every layer pointing backward to its ancestry and forward to its executable rule.
